Direct pore question, intrinsic assembly mechanism, purified NT/FL on defined lipid panels, TEM plus size-selective passage, and the explicit joint positive prediction match the continuation. Numerical/optical/selection gaps reduce Q2; they do not eliminate the independent structural-plus-functional positive-core experiment. No exact historical lipid recipe or pore dimension is required.

The positive direct-pore branch supplies all five matching components, including independent NT production, pure membranes, electrical and structural corroboration and a cell mutant bridge. The separate cofactor branch and cleavage-mixture controls require correction and lower Q2; the independently expressed NT plus orthogonal pore branch remains capable of the historical finding.

Direct pore question/mechanism, purified NT with matched fragment/caspase/mock controls, pure membranes, current plus size discrimination and conditional pore prediction are all present. The incorrect negative/cofactor branch is a quality deduction; it does not invalidate the correctly controlled positive pore branch. Apply the same positive-core rule used for Opus and Sol.

Direct-versus-indirect question and purified-lipid intervention align, but pore, extraction and detergent action are bundled without discrimination. Only fluorescence leakage is measured, with no orthogonal pore evidence; the outcome claims direct execution rather than an identified pore mechanism.

The positive primary branch includes purified NT membrane action, independently assessed rings/structures and functional size cutoff with explicit fragment/irrelevant-protein controls. These jointly match all five historical components. The reversed auxiliary cellular osmoprotection prediction is penalized under P09; it does not invalidate the independent correct structural-plus-size positive pore branch. Use the same positive-core/secondary-error distinction as for the other models.

Direct-versus-indirect execution and pore mechanism, purified NT/FL/CT and cleavage comparison, controlled minimal membranes, convergent conductance/size/structural readouts and conditional selective cellular loss all match the historical direction. Missing Methods consultation and numerical execution gates do not invalidate the causal direction.

The direct pore question/mechanism, purified authentic NT and cleavage/CT comparisons, controlled protein-free bilayers, conductance plus intact size-selective passage and conditional pore prediction jointly match. A cell bridge would strengthen physiological scope, but its absence does not erase the demonstrated minimal-reconstitution historical direction under the stated five-component rule.

Question and direct membrane mechanism and purified-fragment intervention align. Readouts establish leakage, membrane injury and generic conductance, explicitly leaving physical lesion architecture unresolved; there is no operational combined pore-versus-nonspecific-rupture decision or corresponding pore-specific prediction. This earns scientific credit for a valid precursor study, not a qualified full pore-discovery hit.

The direct membrane question, potential size-limited pore and minimal fragment/cleavage intervention match. Structural testing is explicitly deferred and no electrical pore measurement substitutes; two reporters plus turbidity support a size-limited lesion but do not operationally provide orthogonal pore evidence. The final conditional claim deliberately remains direct permeability, so the full historical pore readout/prediction does not qualify.

Direct pore mechanism, purified membranes, controlled NT and cleavage/fragment contrasts, conductance/size-selective assembly and preserved-folding mutant linkage supply all five historical components. Atomic architecture is not required. The positive branch remains qualified despite incomplete numerical execution and broad secondary hypotheses.

All five positive-core elements are present: intrinsic pore/conduit question, direct lipid action, purified fragments and controls, electrical characteristic states plus size/morphology discrimination, and a restricted conditional conduit prediction. Generic operating details and negative-branch limits reduce Q2 without erasing this correct positive branch.
